models_evaluated: lightweight convolutional neural network for OCT lesion classification

links.outcome: Model accuracy compared with ophthalmologists of different experience levels on external OCT images
links.effect: Model average accuracy 89.9% on external validation; junior physicians 74% (95% CI 61.84%-86.16%); mid-level physicians 88% (95% CI 78.99%-97.01%); model approached mid-level physicians.
links.quote: The model achieved an average accuracy of 89.9% on the external validation set, whereas junior physicians demonstrated an accuracy of 74% (95%CI: 61.84%~86.16%) in interpreting OCT images, and that of mid-level physicians was 88% (95%CI: 78.99%~97.01%), indicating the model's performance approached that of mid-level physicians.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a lightweight CNN for multi-lesion detection in OCT images, comparing its retrospective diagnostic performance against ophthalmologists of varying experience levels on external validation datasets.
